scope.purpose: Gather two or more related checkboxes that answer one question, any number of which can be checked, with one group name, one required rule (at least one) and one validation message through Field.
useCases: A required question with several possible answers (Select at least one notification channel).
Optional filters or preferences listed under one label.
A horizontal row of two or three short options (days of the week).
exclusions: Selection limits (at most N, exactly N): later, the application validates them meanwhile.
A select-all checkbox inside the group: it stays outside and the application derives its state from value.
Long or searchable option lists (a multi-select, later).
alternatives: Checkbox alone for a single independent option.
Switch for settings applied at once.

contract.scope: CheckboxGroup contract: bindable list value, label (when no Field), orientation, size, disabled, readonly, invalid, required (at least one, stated in words by the Field); container and 2+ Checkbox items; valueChange; verticalGap space.content.sm, horizontalGap space.content.lg; each checkbox its own tab stop; no validation, no select-all child. With the list prop type added to the contract format.

decisionsTaken: Added to wave 2 by the user on 2026-10-28 (Figma parity review): "Je valide l'ajout du Checkboxgroup pour la vague 2."

Built on the RadioGroup model: Field gives the visible label, description and message; label prop only for use without Field; orientation, size, readonly, invalid and disabled passed to every checkbox; gaps space.content.sm (vertical) and space.content.lg (horizontal), no new token.
value is a list of the checked values (new list prop type in the contract format), in the source order of the checkboxes; each Checkbox gains an optional value prop (contract amendment).
Each checkbox stays its own tab stop and toggles with Space (checkbox convention), unlike the single stop of a RadioGroup.
required means at least one; not exposed as aria-required on each checkbox (it would announce every option as mandatory); the Field label or description states it in words.
Selection limits and a select-all child are out of scope.
Required exposure (user, 2026-10-28): stated in words by the Field label or description, not as required on each checkbox.

Implementation: the Bits UI group required is not passed (it would set aria-required on every checkbox); the group sorts its value by the source order of the checkboxes; the group shares its value through the context so that the server markup shows checked boxes before hydration.
